answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The hollow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
